top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes targeted protein degradation as a design principle: a small molecule recruits an E3 ligase so that a chosen protein is removed rather than occupied, opening targets that binding-site pharmacology could not reach. Crews and Deshaies hold the concept and Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary-complex work made it rational, reproducible chemistry that has spread well beyond the original groups. P003 is a close second because it is the same achievement, but cereblon target identification by Handa is target identification for an existing drug rather than the design step. Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling (P002) is mature and cleanly credited but extends the 2010 cross-coupling logic. Any award is preferred to no award.
